decision_record_name: FireSense Next Experiment Decision Record v0

agreement_analysis.interpretation: The empirical coverage heuristic and Bayesian matched-pair pure-exploration acquisition identify closely aligned thickness regions.

selected_research_candidate.selection_basis: The Bayesian matched-pair candidate is selected as the current research-priority candidate because it directly optimizes posterior uncertainty within the shared empirical thickness domain. The coverage candidate provides internal corroboration of the same region.

evidence_relationship.note: Coverage and Bayesian results are derived from the same frozen Figure 2.21 evidence base. Their agreement is internal convergence, not independent validation.

Coverage and Bayesian methods share the same frozen Figure 2.21 evidence base.
